bias.label: Leaning down below 3,903; Asia bounce fading

event: US PPI (October) today, Fri 13 Nov, at 15:30 SAST (13:30 GMT per FXEmpire and 1Trader). Fed speakers Bowman and Daly later today (times UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Bounce fading
bullets.text: FXEmpire says gold rose to 3,918.59 by 07:18 SAST but stalled at 3,903, and its ticker showed 3,894.75 at 09:30 SAST.

bullets.title: One-year low
bullets.text: Gold fell 2.76% on Thursday to a 13-month low near 3,852 (FXEmpire, Kitco).

bullets.title: Yields above 5%
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield is near 5.10-5.13%, which weighs on gold (FXEmpire, 1Trader).

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index is near a 19-month high, at 102.30 (FXEmpire) or 103.20 (1Trader), so the exact level is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 87-89% odds of a December quarter-point hike, and NY Fed's Williams said more hikes are likely.

bullets.title: Iran and oil
bullets.text: Brent is near 96 dollars after Trump said the US does not need an Iran deal, which may give gold some safe-haven support (1Trader).

bullets.title: PPI at 15:30
bullets.text: October PPI is expected at +0.4% m/m, and FXEmpire says a hot number could push gold toward 3,780.

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,851-3,856 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,851-3,856, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping back to the 3,852 low and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone, not a fast slice through it.
A soft PPI and yields easing back toward 5%.
Take some profit at 3,870 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying just because gold has fallen a lot. The trend is still down.
A hot PPI at 15:30 SAST can push price through 3,852 toward 3,823 or 3,780.
Yields above 5% and Fed hike bets mean bounces may be small and short.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,903

keys.label: Sell zone
keys.value: Rejection at 3,900-3,905, the pivot where the bounce stalled

look: Price bouncing back up to 3,900-3,905 and stalling there again.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close near 3,903.
US yields staying above 5% and the dollar firm.
Take some profit at 3,852 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling in the middle at 3,895, just above 3,870 support. Wait for the retest of 3,903.
Iran and oil headlines can lift gold fast, so a 1H close above 3,937 can run to 3,944-3,950.
PPI at 15:30 SAST can move gold fast either way. Avoid entering in the 15 minutes before it.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
